decision_scope: Current fixed-architecture JEPA and one uniform latent radius per model; deciding whether to invest in Yang-style error certification

evaluation.radius_source: All state-action errors on all 24 stress maps, pooled separately for each frozen checkpoint
evaluation.membership: Closed Euclidean ball; same-map target encoder; no repair or topology filter
evaluation.nontrivial_filter: Exclude source-label base cases before primary CTL scoring
evaluation.balanced_score: Macro-average positive/negative recall balance over the three primary properties
evaluation.opportunity_recall: Audited correct non-immediate one-sided claims / exact graph non-immediate one-sided claims

failure_action: Stop this Yang-style uniform-radius research route for the current JEPA; retain results as a negative experiment. Do not tune this suite or add certification machinery.
interpretation: This is a prespecified research screening rule, not a statistical significance test or an impossibility theorem about Yang 2025. Ten percentage points and ten percent recall are engineering decision thresholds.
